/pdf-to-word.name: PDF to Word
/pdf-to-word.title: PDF to Word Converter — CloudConvert | PDF Palette
/pdf-to-word.description: Convert PDF to an editable Word (.docx) document free. CloudConvert preserves layout, fonts and tables.
/pdf-to-word.intro: Turn a PDF back into an editable Word document. PDF Palette sends the file to CloudConvert, which rebuilds it as a .docx you can open and edit in Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice. The file is used for conversion only and is not stored by PDF Palette.
steps: Drop your PDF onto the upload area, or click to pick a file.
Wait while CloudConvert converts the document.
Download the .docx file and open it in Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice.

faqs.q: Will the formatting stay the same?
faqs.a: Fonts, sizes, colours, alignment, tables and images are reconstructed from the PDF. Complex multi-column magazine layouts may need a little cleanup, but ordinary documents — reports, CVs, letters, invoices — come across closely.

faqs.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: A scanned page is an image, so there is no text to extract. Run it through the OCR PDF tool first to add a text layer, then convert it to Word.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: Yes — this tool sends the PDF to CloudConvert for conversion. PDF Palette does not keep a copy after the download is ready. See the Privacy Policy.

faqs.q: Is there a file size or page limit?
faqs.a: CloudConvert accepts typical document sizes. Very large scanned PDFs may take longer to convert.

/pdf-to-word-2.name: PDF to Word 2
/pdf-to-word-2.title: PDF to Word 2 — Convert and Compare in Apryse WebViewer | PDF Palette
/pdf-to-word-2.description: Convert a PDF to Word, then flip between the .docx and the original in an embedded Apryse WebViewer before you download.
/pdf-to-word-2.intro: The same conversion as PDF to Word, with a check step on the end. Once the .docx comes back, this tool opens it in an embedded Apryse WebViewer and lets you flip between the converted document and the original PDF in the same pane, so layout drift is easy to spot before you download anything. Useful when fidelity matters more than speed.
steps: Drop your PDF onto the upload area, or click to pick a file.
Wait while the document is converted to .docx.
Flip between the converted document and the original PDF in the viewer.
Download the .docx if it looks right.

faqs.q: How is this different from PDF to Word?
faqs.a: The conversion is identical. This tool adds a preview: it renders the resulting Word document and the source PDF in the browser and lets you switch between them, so you can spot layout problems before downloading instead of opening the file in Word to find out.

faqs.q: Why does the viewer say Demo?
faqs.a: Apryse WebViewer stamps a demo watermark on documents when no license key is configured. The watermark is added by the viewer only — it is never written into the .docx you download.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere new?
faqs.a: No. The preview is rendered entirely in your browser by WebViewer. Conversion uses the same service as the standard PDF to Word tool, and nothing extra leaves your machine for the preview step.

/word-to-pdf.name: Word to PDF
/word-to-pdf.title: Word to PDF Converter — CloudConvert | PDF Palette
/word-to-pdf.description: Convert Word documents to PDF free. CloudConvert preserves fonts, tables, images and page layout.
/word-to-pdf.intro: Convert a .docx or .doc file into a PDF that looks the way your document does. PDF Palette sends the file to CloudConvert, which keeps fonts, colours, tables, images, headers and page breaks. The file is used for conversion only and is not stored by PDF Palette.
steps: Select the Word document you want to convert.
Wait while CloudConvert converts the document.
Download the finished PDF.

faqs.q: Do I need Microsoft Word installed?
faqs.a: No. Nothing is installed and no PDF Palette account is needed. CloudConvert performs the conversion.

faqs.q: Are fonts embedded in the PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Fonts used by the document are embedded so the PDF renders the same on any device.

faqs.q: Can I convert .doc as well as .docx?
faqs.a: Both are accepted. Modern .docx files give the most faithful result.

faqs.q: Will hyperlinks still work?
faqs.a: Links in the document are carried into the PDF and stay clickable.

/compress-pdf.name: Compress PDF
/compress-pdf.title: Compress PDF — Reduce PDF File Size Free | PDF Palette
/compress-pdf.description: Compress PDF files to a smaller size while keeping them readable. Choose a compression level and download — the file is processed in your browser.
/compress-pdf.intro: Shrink a PDF so it fits an email attachment limit or an upload form. PDF Palette runs a real Ghostscript pipeline compiled to WebAssembly, so image downsampling and stream compression happen in your tab rather than on someone else's server. Pick a level, see the size before and after, and download.
steps: Add the PDF you want to make smaller.
Choose a compression level — higher compression means smaller files and softer images.
Compare the original and compressed sizes, then download the result.

faqs.q: How much smaller will my file get?
faqs.a: It depends on what is in it. Scans and photo-heavy PDFs often drop by 60–90%. A PDF that is mostly text is already small and will shrink much less.

faqs.q: Will the text stay sharp?
faqs.a: Yes. Text stays as text and remains selectable and searchable. Compression mainly reduces the resolution and quality of embedded images.

faqs.q: Which level should I pick?
faqs.a: Start with the middle setting for email attachments. Use the strongest level only when the file must fit a hard limit and print quality does not matter.

faqs.q: Can I compress a password-protected PDF?
faqs.a: Not directly. Remove the password with the Unlock PDF tool first, then compress.

/merge-pdf.name: Merge PDF
/merge-pdf.title: Merge PDF — Combine PDF Files Free | PDF Palette
/merge-pdf.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document, in the order you choose. Free, no sign-up, and merged entirely in your browser.
/merge-pdf.intro: Join several PDFs into a single document — contracts and their annexes, a scanned form and its attachments, chapters into one report. Add up to 20 files, arrange them in the order you want, and download one combined PDF. Nothing is uploaded.
steps: Add two or more PDF files.
Check the order in the file list — the documents are combined top to bottom.
Merge, then download the single combined PDF.

faqs.q: How many PDFs can I merge at once?
faqs.a: Up to 20 files in one pass. To combine more, merge in batches and then merge the results.

faqs.q: Does merging reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied as-is, so text stays selectable and images keep their original resolution.

faqs.q: Can I merge PDFs with different page sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Each page keeps its own size and orientation in the merged document.

faqs.q: What about bookmarks and form fields?
faqs.a: Page content is preserved. Interactive form fields from multiple files can collide, so flatten forms first if the result matters.

/split-pdf.name: Split PDF
/split-pdf.title: Split PDF — Separate PDF Pages Free | PDF Palette
/split-pdf.description: Split a PDF by page ranges or into one file per page. Pick exactly what you need and download — processed in your browser, never uploaded.
/split-pdf.intro: Break a large PDF into smaller ones. Split by page ranges to pull out a chapter or a signed section, or split into one file per page when you need every page separately. You see the page thumbnails as you choose, so you can check before you download.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to split.
Choose page ranges, or select split-into-single-pages.
Download the resulting files.

faqs.q: Can I split into uneven ranges?
faqs.a: Yes. Define each range separately — for example 1–3, 4, and 9–12 — and each becomes its own PDF.

faqs.q: Does splitting change the pages?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied unchanged, so text, images and quality are identical to the original.

faqs.q: How do I keep only some pages instead?
faqs.a: Use Extract Pages to pull a selection into one new PDF, or Remove Pages to delete the ones you do not want.

faqs.q: Can I split a password-protected PDF?
faqs.a: Remove the password with Unlock PDF first, then split.

/pdf-to-jpg.name: PDF to JPG
/pdf-to-jpg.title: PDF to JPG — Convert PDF Pages to Images | PDF Palette
/pdf-to-jpg.description: Convert every page of a PDF into a JPG or PNG image at up to 300 dpi. Free, no sign-up, and rendered entirely in your browser.
/pdf-to-jpg.intro: Turn PDF pages into images you can drop into a slide, a post or a document. Choose JPG for smaller files or PNG for lossless edges, and pick a resolution from screen quality up to 300 dpi for print. Each page becomes one image file.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Choose the format (JPG or PNG) and the resolution — 96, 150 or 300 dpi.
Convert and download the page images.

faqs.q: Which resolution should I choose?
faqs.a: 96 dpi for on-screen use, 150 dpi for a good general-purpose image, and 300 dpi when the image will be printed.

faqs.q: JPG or PNG?
faqs.a: JPG gives much smaller files and suits scans and photographs. PNG is lossless and keeps text edges and line art crisp.

faqs.q: Can I convert only one page?
faqs.a: Extract the page you want with Extract Pages first, then convert that single-page PDF to an image.

faqs.q: Are the images watermarked?
faqs.a: No. There are no watermarks and no limits — the tool is free.

/jpg-to-pdf.name: JPG to PDF
/jpg-to-pdf.title: JPG to PDF — Convert Images to PDF Free | PDF Palette
/jpg-to-pdf.description: Turn JPG and PNG images into a single PDF document. Add up to 30 images, set the order, and download — all in your browser.
/jpg-to-pdf.intro: Combine photos or scans into one PDF. Add up to 30 JPG or PNG images and each becomes a page, in the order you arrange them. Useful for turning phone photos of a document, receipts or ID scans into something you can attach or print.
steps: Add your JPG or PNG images.
Check the order — one image becomes one page, top to bottom.
Create the PDF and download it.

faqs.q: How many images can I add?
faqs.a: Up to 30 in one PDF. For more, build several PDFs and combine them with Merge PDF.

faqs.q: Are the images compressed?
faqs.a: Images are placed at their own resolution. If the PDF comes out large, run it through Compress PDF afterwards.

faqs.q: Can I mix JPG and PNG?
faqs.a: Yes. Both formats can appear in the same document.

faqs.q: Will the pages be portrait or landscape?
faqs.a: Each page follows the orientation of its image, so wide photos become landscape pages.

/pdf-to-excel.name: PDF to Excel
/pdf-to-excel.title: PDF to Excel — Extract Tables to XLSX Free | PDF Palette
/pdf-to-excel.description: Extract tables from a PDF into an editable Excel spreadsheet. Rows and columns are detected automatically, and the file never leaves your browser.
/pdf-to-excel.intro: Pull tabular data out of a PDF and into a spreadsheet you can actually calculate with. PDF Palette detects table structure from the position of the text on the page — column boundaries, row breaks and merged cells — and writes a .xlsx file with the values in real cells.
steps: Upload the PDF containing the table or tables.
Let the table detection pass run over each page.
Download the .xlsx file and open it in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

faqs.q: Does it work on tables without gridlines?
faqs.a: Yes. Columns are inferred from where the text sits on the page, so ruled and unruled tables both work. Ruled tables are usually more accurate.

faqs.q: Will formulas be recreated?
faqs.a: No. A PDF stores only the calculated values, not the formulas behind them, so the spreadsheet contains numbers.

faqs.q: What about scanned tables?
faqs.a: Run OCR PDF first to add a text layer, then extract to Excel.

faqs.q: Are multiple tables kept separate?
faqs.a: Tables found on different pages are written to the sheet in page order so you can see where each one came from.

/excel-to-pdf.name: Excel to PDF
/excel-to-pdf.title: Excel to PDF — Convert XLSX to PDF Free | PDF Palette
/excel-to-pdf.description: Convert Excel spreadsheets to PDF with cell formatting, borders and number formats intact. Free, no sign-up, converted in your browser.
/excel-to-pdf.intro: Turn a spreadsheet into a PDF that anyone can open and that nobody can accidentally edit. Cell values, number formats, fonts, fills and borders are laid out page by page, so the printed result matches what you see in the sheet.
steps: Upload your .xlsx or .xls file.
Wait while each sheet is laid out onto pages.
Download the PDF.

faqs.q: Are all worksheets included?
faqs.a: Yes. Each sheet is laid out in turn and appended to the same PDF.

faqs.q: Do number and date formats carry over?
faqs.a: Yes. Currency, percentages, decimals and date formats are rendered as they appear in the spreadsheet, not as raw values.

faqs.q: What happens to very wide sheets?
faqs.a: Wide sheets are split across pages so no columns are lost. Reduce the column count or widths first if you need it on one page.

faqs.q: Are charts included?
faqs.a: Cell content, formatting and borders are the focus. Embedded chart objects may not be reproduced.

/pdf-to-powerpoint.name: PDF to PowerPoint
/pdf-to-powerpoint.title: PDF to PowerPoint — Convert PDF to PPTX | PDF Palette
/pdf-to-powerpoint.description: Convert a PDF into an editable PowerPoint presentation, one slide per page. Free, no watermark, and converted entirely in your browser.
/pdf-to-powerpoint.intro: Turn a PDF back into a presentation. Each PDF page becomes a slide, with the text placed in editable text boxes rather than flattened into a picture, so you can rework the deck in PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Each page is analysed and rebuilt as a slide.
Download the .pptx and open it in your presentation app.

faqs.q: Is the text editable afterwards?
faqs.a: Yes. Text is placed into real text boxes, so you can retype and restyle it rather than being stuck with an image.

faqs.q: Will the slide size match my deck?
faqs.a: Slide dimensions follow the PDF page size and orientation, so a landscape PDF gives landscape slides.

faqs.q: What about animations and transitions?
faqs.a: A PDF contains no animation data, so the result is a static deck.

faqs.q: Does it work on scanned pages?
faqs.a: Run OCR PDF first so there is text to place; otherwise the page can only be carried across as an image.

/powerpoint-to-pdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
/powerpoint-to-pdf.title: PowerPoint to PDF — Convert PPTX to PDF Free | PDF Palette
/powerpoint-to-pdf.description: Convert PowerPoint presentations to PDF with layout, fonts and images preserved. One slide per page, free, and processed in your browser.
/powerpoint-to-pdf.intro: Share a deck as a PDF so it opens the same way everywhere and nobody needs PowerPoint. Each slide becomes one page, with text, fonts, colours, images and shape positions laid out as they appear in the presentation.
steps: Upload your .pptx or .ppt file.
Each slide is rendered onto its own page.
Download the PDF.

faqs.q: Are speaker notes included?
faqs.a: No. The PDF contains the slides themselves, which is what you normally want to circulate.

faqs.q: Will the page size match the slide size?
faqs.a: Yes. Page dimensions follow the slide dimensions, so 16:9 decks stay 16:9.

faqs.q: Are fonts embedded?
faqs.a: Yes, so the PDF looks the same on a machine that does not have those fonts installed.

faqs.q: Can I make the PDF smaller afterwards?
faqs.a: Image-heavy decks can produce large PDFs. Run the result through Compress PDF.

/edit-pdf.name: Edit PDF
/edit-pdf.title: Edit PDF Online Free — Add Text and Shapes | PDF Palette
/edit-pdf.description: Add text, images, shapes, highlights and annotations to a PDF in your browser. Free PDF editor with no sign-up and no watermark.
/edit-pdf.intro: Mark up a PDF without buying an editor. Add text boxes, drop in images, draw shapes and arrows, highlight passages and leave notes, then save a new PDF with your changes baked in. Everything happens in the tab — the document is never uploaded.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to edit.
Use the toolbar to add text, images, shapes, highlights or freehand drawing on any page.
Save and download the edited PDF.

faqs.q: Can I edit the text that is already in the PDF?
faqs.a: This editor adds new content on top of the page. To rewrite existing body text, convert to Word, edit there, and convert back to PDF.

faqs.q: Is there a watermark on the result?
faqs.a: No. There are no watermarks, no sign-up and no export limits.

faqs.q: Can I delete something from the page?
faqs.a: To genuinely remove content rather than cover it, use Redact PDF — drawing a box over text does not delete the text underneath.

faqs.q: Are my edits saved automatically?
faqs.a: No. Work lives in the tab only, so download the result before closing it.

/sign-pdf.name: Sign PDF
/sign-pdf.title: Sign PDF Online Free — Add Your Signature | PDF Palette
/sign-pdf.description: Draw, type or upload a signature and place it anywhere on a PDF. Free electronic signing with no account, done entirely in your browser.
/sign-pdf.intro: Sign a document without printing and scanning it. Draw your signature with a mouse or finger, type it in a handwriting style, or upload an image of it, then position and resize it on any page. Add a date or initials alongside it and download the signed PDF.
steps: Upload the PDF you need to sign.
Create your signature — draw it, type it, or upload an image.
Place and resize it on the page, then download the signed document.

faqs.q: Is an electronic signature legally valid?
faqs.a: In many jurisdictions a typed or drawn electronic signature is accepted for ordinary agreements, but requirements vary by country and document type. Check what your situation requires.

faqs.q: Does this send a signature request to someone else?
faqs.a: No. This tool places your own signature on a document. It does not manage signing workflows, recipients or audit trails.

faqs.q: Is my signature stored anywhere?
faqs.a: No. It exists only in your browser tab and is discarded when you close it.

faqs.q: Can I sign more than one page?
faqs.a: Yes. Place a signature, initials or a date on as many pages as you need before downloading.

/ocr-pdf.name: OCR PDF
/ocr-pdf.title: OCR PDF Free — Make Scanned PDFs Searchable | PDF Palette
/ocr-pdf.description: Run OCR on a scanned PDF to make its text searchable and selectable. Free, no upload — the recognition engine runs inside your browser.
/ocr-pdf.intro: A scanned document is just a picture of text: you cannot search it, select it or copy from it. OCR adds an invisible text layer behind the image so the page looks identical but becomes searchable, selectable and ready for conversion to Word or Excel.
steps: Upload the scanned PDF.
Wait for recognition to finish — this is the slowest step, and it runs on your own device.
Download the searchable PDF.

faqs.q: Does the page look different afterwards?
faqs.a: No. The original scan is untouched; the recognised text sits invisibly behind it, aligned with what you see.

faqs.q: How accurate is it?
faqs.a: Clean, straight, high-resolution scans of printed text read very well. Low-resolution, skewed or handwritten pages are much less reliable.

faqs.q: Why does it take so long?
faqs.a: Character recognition is genuinely heavy work, and it is running on your machine rather than a server farm. Larger documents take proportionally longer.

faqs.q: Can I then convert it to Word?
faqs.a: Yes — that is the usual next step. Once the text layer exists, PDF to Word and PDF to Excel both work on the document.

/unlock-pdf.name: Unlock PDF
/unlock-pdf.title: Unlock PDF — Remove PDF Password Free | PDF Palette
/unlock-pdf.description: Remove password protection from a PDF you own so it opens without a prompt. Free, no sign-up, and unlocked entirely in your browser.
/unlock-pdf.intro: Take the password off a PDF you are entitled to open. Supply the password once and download a copy that opens freely — useful for bank statements and payslips that arrive encrypted and that you need to archive, print or convert.
steps: Upload the protected PDF.
Enter the password that opens it.
Download the unlocked copy.

faqs.q: Do I need to know the password?
faqs.a: Yes. This tool removes protection from a document you can already open — it does not crack or guess passwords.

faqs.q: Is it legal to remove a PDF password?
faqs.a: Only remove protection from documents you own or are authorised to modify. Bypassing protection on someone else's document may be unlawful.

faqs.q: Is my password sent anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Decryption happens in your browser, so neither the file nor the password leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can I add protection again later?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Protect PDF to set a new password on the result.

/protect-pdf.name: Protect PDF
/protect-pdf.title: Protect PDF — Add a Password to a PDF Free | PDF Palette
/protect-pdf.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password so only people who know it can open the file. Free, no account, and encrypted in your browser.
/protect-pdf.intro: Put a password on a document before you email or share it. The PDF is encrypted so it cannot be opened without the password — which means the password itself has to reach the recipient some other way, not in the same message as the file.
steps: Upload the PDF you want to protect.
Choose a password and confirm it.
Download the encrypted PDF and share the password separately.

faqs.q: What happens if I forget the password?
faqs.a: The document cannot be recovered. Nothing is stored here, so keep the password somewhere safe before you send the file.

faqs.q: How strong is the encryption?
faqs.a: The PDF is encrypted with standard PDF encryption. As always, the real strength is the password you choose — long and unique beats short and clever.

faqs.q: Is my password uploaded?
faqs.a: No. Encryption runs in your browser, so the file and the password both stay on your device.

faqs.q: Can I still compress or edit it afterwards?
faqs.a: Not while it is encrypted. Do any other processing first, and add the password as the last step.

/rotate-pdf.name: Rotate PDF
/rotate-pdf.title: Rotate PDF — Fix Page Orientation Free | PDF Palette
/rotate-pdf.description: Rotate PDF pages 90, 180 or 270 degrees and save the correct orientation permanently. Free, no sign-up, rotated in your browser.
/rotate-pdf.intro: Fix a document that was scanned sideways or upside down. Choose how far to turn the pages and download a PDF that opens the right way up everywhere — unlike rotating in a viewer, which usually only changes what you see on screen.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Choose the rotation — 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
Download the corrected PDF.

faqs.q: Is the rotation permanent?
faqs.a: Yes. The page orientation is written into the file, so it opens correctly in any reader.

faqs.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faqs.a: This tool turns every page by the same amount. To rotate individual pages, use Organize PDF, which rotates page by page.

faqs.q: Does rotating reduce quality?
faqs.a: No. Nothing is re-rendered — only the page orientation flag changes.

faqs.q: Why does my viewer show it sideways again?
faqs.a: Some viewers remember their own per-document rotation. Reopen the downloaded file in a fresh window to check.

/organize-pdf.name: Organize PDF
/organize-pdf.title: Organize PDF — Reorder and Delete Pages | PDF Palette
/organize-pdf.description: Reorder, rotate, duplicate and delete PDF pages visually with page thumbnails. Free, no sign-up, organised entirely in your browser.
/organize-pdf.intro: Rearrange a document by looking at it. Every page appears as a thumbnail you can drag into a new position, rotate on its own, duplicate or delete. It is the fastest way to fix a scan that came out in the wrong order or to drop the pages you do not need.
steps: Upload the PDF to see all its pages as thumbnails.
Drag pages into order, and rotate, duplicate or delete individual pages.
Apply your changes and download the reorganised PDF.

faqs.q: Can I rotate just one page?
faqs.a: Yes. Each thumbnail has its own rotation control, unlike Rotate PDF which turns the whole document.

faqs.q: Can I combine pages from two documents?
faqs.a: Merge the files first with Merge PDF, then open the result here to arrange every page together.

faqs.q: Is the original file changed?
faqs.a: No. Your original stays untouched on disk — you download a new PDF.

faqs.q: Does page quality change?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied, not re-rendered, so text and images are identical.

/watermark-pdf.name: Watermark PDF
/watermark-pdf.title: Watermark PDF — Add Text Watermark Free | PDF Palette
/watermark-pdf.description: Stamp a text watermark such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL across every page of a PDF. Free, no sign-up, applied in your browser.
/watermark-pdf.intro: Mark a document before you circulate it. Add text like DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL or your company name diagonally across every page, so a copy is recognisable wherever it ends up.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Type the watermark text you want stamped across the pages.
Apply it and download the watermarked PDF.

faqs.q: Does the watermark cover every page?
faqs.a: Yes. The text is applied across all pages in one pass.

faqs.q: Can the watermark be removed afterwards?
faqs.a: A watermark is a deterrent, not a security control — it is drawn into the page and can be worked around by a determined person. Use Protect PDF when you need real access control.

faqs.q: Does it hide the text underneath?
faqs.a: No. The watermark sits over the content but the document stays readable and the text underneath stays selectable.

faqs.q: Can I use an image as the watermark?
faqs.a: For an image or logo overlay, use Edit PDF, which lets you place an image and set where it sits.

/html-to-pdf.name: HTML to PDF
/html-to-pdf.title: HTML to PDF — Convert Web Pages to PDF | PDF Palette
/html-to-pdf.description: Convert an HTML file or a web page URL into a PDF with selectable, searchable text. Free, with no sign-up required and no watermark added.
/html-to-pdf.intro: Save a web page or an HTML file as a PDF you can archive, print or share. The text stays selectable and searchable rather than being flattened into a picture. Uploading an HTML file is converted entirely in your browser; converting a live URL is the one case where the address has to be fetched for you, because a browser tab cannot load arbitrary third-party pages on your behalf.
steps: Upload an .html file, or paste the address of the page you want to capture.
Wait while the page is laid out onto PDF pages.
Download the PDF.

faqs.q: Is the text in the PDF searchable?
faqs.a: Yes. The page is typeset rather than screenshotted, so text can be selected, searched and copied.

faqs.q: Does converting a URL upload anything of mine?
faqs.a: No file of yours is uploaded. Only the public address you paste is fetched so its content can be rendered, and it is discarded straight after the download. Uploading an HTML file never leaves your browser.

faqs.q: Can it capture a page behind a login?
faqs.a: No. Only publicly reachable pages can be fetched. Save the page from your browser as an HTML file and upload that instead.

faqs.q: Will the layout match the website exactly?
faqs.a: The page is re-typeset for paper, so it reflows to page width. Heavily interactive or script-driven pages may differ from what you see on screen.

/extract-pages.name: Extract Pages
/extract-pages.title: Extract PDF Pages — Save Selected Pages Free | PDF Palette
/extract-pages.description: Pull selected pages out of a PDF into a new document. Pick pages visually from thumbnails, free, with no sign-up and no upload to a server.
/extract-pages.intro: Keep only the pages you need. Select them from the page thumbnails — a single page, a range, or a scattered handful — and download them as one new PDF. The original file is untouched.
steps: Upload the PDF and browse the page thumbnails.
Select the pages you want to keep.
Extract and download them as a new PDF.

faqs.q: How is this different from Split PDF?
faqs.a: Split divides a document into several files. Extract gathers a chosen set of pages into one new file.

faqs.q: Can I pick pages that are not next to each other?
faqs.a: Yes. Select any combination — for example pages 1, 4 and 9 — and they are collected in page order.

faqs.q: Are the extracted pages identical to the originals?
faqs.a: Yes. Pages are copied without re-rendering, so text and image quality are unchanged.

faqs.q: How do I do the opposite?
faqs.a: Use Remove Pages to delete a selection and keep everything else.

/remove-pages.name: Remove Pages
/remove-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages — Remove Pages Free | PDF Palette
/remove-pages.description: Delete unwanted pages from a PDF and keep the rest. Choose pages visually from thumbnails, free, with no sign-up and nothing uploaded.
/remove-pages.intro: Drop the pages you do not want — a blank scan, a cover sheet, an internal note before sending the file on. Select them from the thumbnails and download the document without them.
steps: Upload the PDF to see its pages.
Select the pages to delete.
Download the PDF with those pages removed.

faqs.q: Is the content really gone?
faqs.a: The removed pages are not in the new file at all. Note that removing a page does not redact anything on the pages you keep — use Redact PDF for that.

faqs.q: Can I undo it?
faqs.a: Your original file on disk is never modified, so you can always start again from it.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on how many pages I can remove?
faqs.a: No, as long as at least one page remains.

faqs.q: How do I keep only a few pages instead?
faqs.a: Use Extract Pages, which works the other way round.

/page-numbers.name: Add Page Numbers
/page-numbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF — Free | PDF Palette
/page-numbers.description: Insert page numbers into a PDF with your choice of position, format and starting number. Free, no sign-up, applied in your browser.
/page-numbers.intro: Number a document that arrived without numbers. Choose where the number sits on the page, which format to use, and what number to start from — useful for exhibits, bundles and anything that has to be referenced page by page.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Choose the position, format and starting number.
Apply the numbering and download the result.

faqs.q: Can I start from a number other than 1?
faqs.a: Yes. Set any starting number — useful when the document is one part of a larger bundle.

faqs.q: Where can the numbers be placed?
faqs.a: Choose from the standard header and footer positions, left, centre or right.

faqs.q: Will the numbers cover existing content?
faqs.a: They are placed in the page margin. If a page already has a footer, pick a different position.

faqs.q: Can I skip the cover page?
faqs.a: Set the starting number to account for it, or remove the cover, number the rest, and merge it back with Merge PDF.

/crop-pdf.name: Crop PDF
/crop-pdf.title: Crop PDF — Trim Page Margins Free | PDF Palette
/crop-pdf.description: Crop PDF pages to remove white margins or trim scan edges. Set the visible area by dragging, free, with nothing uploaded to a server.
/crop-pdf.intro: Trim away wide margins or the black edges left by a scanner. Drag a crop area over the page and apply it, and the visible page area shrinks to what you selected — handy for reading on a small screen, where wasted margin means smaller text.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Drag the crop area to the region you want to keep.
Apply the crop and download the trimmed PDF.

faqs.q: Is the cropped-off content deleted?
faqs.a: Cropping changes the visible page area rather than erasing content. If material must be genuinely removed, use Redact PDF.

faqs.q: Does the crop apply to every page?
faqs.a: The selected area is applied across the document, which suits scans where every page has the same margins.

faqs.q: Can I undo a crop?
faqs.a: Your original file is unchanged, so start again from it if the crop was not right.

faqs.q: Will cropping make the file smaller?
faqs.a: Not by much — the underlying content is still there. Use Compress PDF to reduce the file size.

/fill-forms.name: Fill PDF Forms
/fill-forms.title: Fill PDF Forms Online Free — No Sign-up | PDF Palette
/fill-forms.description: Fill in PDF form fields in your browser and optionally lock them so the answers cannot be changed. Free, with nothing uploaded.
/fill-forms.intro: Complete a PDF form without printing it. Interactive fields — text boxes, checkboxes, dropdowns — are detected and filled in place, and you can flatten the form on the way out so the answers become part of the page and cannot be edited afterwards.
steps: Upload the PDF form.
Fill in the detected fields.
Choose whether to lock the answers, then download the completed form.

faqs.q: What if the PDF has no interactive fields?
faqs.a: Some forms are just printed lines. Use Edit PDF to place text anywhere on the page instead.

faqs.q: What does locking the fields do?
faqs.a: It flattens the form: your answers become part of the page content, so a recipient cannot alter them or clear the form.

faqs.q: Is the data I type sent anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Fields are filled in your browser, so what you type stays on your device.

faqs.q: Can I sign the form too?
faqs.a: Yes. Fill it here, then add a signature with Sign PDF.

/redact-pdf.name: Redact PDF
/redact-pdf.title: Redact PDF — Permanently Remove Content | PDF Palette
/redact-pdf.description: Permanently remove text and images from a PDF, not just cover them up. Free redaction that runs entirely in your browser, with nothing uploaded.
/redact-pdf.intro: Black out sensitive information so it is actually gone. Drawing a rectangle over text in most editors only hides it — the words are still in the file and can be copied straight back out. This tool rebuilds the redacted pages so the underlying content no longer exists in the document.
steps: Upload the PDF.
Draw redaction boxes over the text or images to remove.
Apply the redactions and download the cleaned PDF.

faqs.q: Is the content really removed?
faqs.a: Yes. Redacted pages are rebuilt so the covered content is not present in the output file and cannot be selected, copied or recovered from it.

faqs.q: Why can't I just draw a black box in an editor?
faqs.a: Because the text stays underneath. Anyone can select it, copy it, or read it from the file's internals — that mistake has caused a long list of public disclosures.

faqs.q: Does redacting affect the rest of the page?
faqs.a: Redacted pages are rebuilt as images, so text on those pages is no longer selectable. Run OCR PDF afterwards if you need it searchable again.

faqs.q: What about metadata?
faqs.a: Redaction addresses page content. Check document properties separately if the file's metadata could also be sensitive.

/compare-pdf.name: Compare PDF
/compare-pdf.title: Compare PDF Files — Spot the Differences Free | PDF Palette
/compare-pdf.description: Compare two versions of a PDF side by side and see exactly what changed. Free, no sign-up, and compared entirely in your browser.
/compare-pdf.intro: Find out what actually changed between two versions of a document. Load both files and the differences are highlighted page by page, so you can check a revised contract or a re-issued report without reading it line by line.
steps: Upload the original PDF and the revised one.
Review the highlighted differences page by page.
Note the changes, or download the comparison.

faqs.q: What kinds of changes are detected?
faqs.a: Text that was added, removed or altered, along with pages that moved. It is aimed at document revisions rather than pixel-level image diffs.

faqs.q: Do the documents need the same number of pages?
faqs.a: No. Documents of different lengths are compared and inserted or deleted pages are shown as such.

faqs.q: Are both files uploaded?
faqs.a: No. Both are read and compared in your browser, which matters when you are comparing draft contracts.

faqs.q: Does it work on scanned documents?
faqs.a: There must be text to compare, so run both files through OCR PDF first.
